finding.title: The code uses `kill(getppid(), SIGINT)` to send a signal to the parent process. While this is not directly related to OS command injection, it is important to ensure that the signal handling is secure.
The code uses `pause()` to wait for a signal. This can be a potential issue if the signal handling is not properly managed.
The code uses `exit()` with unique non-zero codes. While this is not directly related to OS command injection, it is important to ensure that the exit codes are properly managed.

The code uses `read(pipefd[0], &buf, 1)` and `write(pipefd[1], "r", 1)` to synchronize between the parent and child processes. While this is not directly related to OS command injection, it is important to ensure that the synchronization is secure.
